preservedResponsibilities: Native HTML import foundation for Markdown raw HTML: pinned token/option/entity/color tables, mutable option scanners, text/entity/quote/whitespace automaton, raw script/style/comment scanner, paired-token/tag/EOF scanner, PRE/listing/XMP filters, and shared SvParser incremental character conversion, ring replay and saved state.
